items.source: A class thus annotated is eligible for Spring DataAccessException translation when used in conjunction with a PersistenceExceptionTranslationPostProcessor. The annotated class is also clarified as to its role in the overall application architecture for the purpose of tooling, aspects, etc.
items.translation: 因此，带有此类注解的类在配合使用 PersistenceExceptionTranslationPostProcessor 时，有资格进行 Spring DataAccessException 转换。此外，该注解类还明确了其在整体应用程序架构中的角色，以便于工具、切面等使用。

items.source: This annotation also serves as a specialization of @Component, allowing for implementation classes to be autodetected through classpath scanning.
items.translation: 此注解也是 `@Component` 的特化形式，允许通过类路径扫描自动检测实现类。

items.source:
Teams implementing traditional Jakarta EE patterns such as "Data Access Object"
may also apply this stereotype to DAO classes, though care should be taken to
understand the distinction between Data Access Object and DDD-style repositories
before doing so. This annotation is a general-purpose stereotype and individual teams
may narrow their semantics and use as appropriate.
items.translation: 实现传统 Jakarta EE 模式（如“数据访问对象”）的团队也可以将此立体角色应用于 DAO 类，但在这样做之前，应仔细理解数据访问对象与 DDD 风格仓库之间的区别。此注解是一个通用立体角色，各个团队可以缩小其语义含义并酌情使用。
